name: FONBET
note: League title partner; the KHL championship carries the FONBET name. Private betting company; ownership not traced. Club-level partner of Metallurg Magnitogorsk from 2022, extended through 2028 (sports.ru, 2025-09-03); logo on the 2026/27 game kit, front and sleeve. Russian media (RIA Novosti via sportliga.com, 2026-03-20) name Valentin Golovanov as Fonbet's 'managing shareholder' (управляющий акционер); beneficial ownership not publicly documented in sources opened.
